excerpt.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

sections.zh: 易爆微粒月度结余为正

texts.zh: 由于管理缺失和大肆的浪费，我们的易爆微粒库存已经完全枯竭！这种战略资源在包括合金冶炼和军事发展等诸多领域有着广泛的应用。尽快补充库存对确保我们帝国经济繁荣至关重要。
texts.en: Due to mismanagement and reckless expenditures, our Volatile Motes reserves have completely evaporated! This strategic resource is widely used in multiple fields, ranging from alloys production to military development. Replenishing our supplies is of paramount importance to ensure the economic prosperity of our empire.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取易爆微粒。
label.en: Siphon volatile motes from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超罕见”微粒。
label.en: We can live with our motes becoming more elusive.

texts.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的经济危机。由于无法弥补赤字，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
texts.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide economic crash. Unable to repay our deficits, we were forced to declare bankruptcy and forfeit on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

texts.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的补给链崩溃。很显然我们已经无法继续维持我们对该物质的消耗。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
texts.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide supply chain crash. It has become clear that we can no longer sustain our use of this material. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

texts.zh: 我们各世界之间易爆微粒的短缺已造成广泛的混乱，尤其是那些生命完全依赖于它的极端微生物共生体。为了防止生命和生产力的进一步损失，我们现在必须实行剧烈的变革，以确保基本生命的延续，希望我们能尽快恢复平衡。
texts.en: The shortage of Volatile Motes among our worlds has caused widespread disruption, not least to those extremophile worker-symbionts whose very lives depend on it. To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now institute drastic change to ensure basic continuity of life, in the hopes we might soon regain equilibrium.
